summary: Both Expect lines hold at 1cf8053 and CI is green apart from the verdict gate (no verdict at the head yet). ci run 41096516680 (test job 124203574083) success, clean-room run 41096516933 (job 124203575078) success, verdict run 41096516724 failure for lack of a verdict. Fix judged: for an install that is not itself a release (tag null) the release check passes when the commit contains the newest release, is unknown when git can't tell, and fails when it does not contain it; a tagged install fails on version for every contained value. Mutation 1: forcing the 'contained !== false' condition to true turned 'release: an older install fails unless it is an untagged commit that contains the release, or git cannot tell' (test 23) red. Mutation 2: dropping the '!f.plugin.tag' guard turned the same test red, so the tagged-install path, untested before, is now covered. Accepted weakening: a non-release install in a clone that can't compare is 'unknown' (6 of 7 checks, Not checked note) rather than failed. Local at 1cf8053: plugins/harness tests 25/25; npm test 152/152 also with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1; plan ok; clean room hooks, claude -p (both 0.1.0, 7 of 7) and release mode (harness-v0.1.1, 7 of 7) pass. Scratch proof (run 41094393695) unchanged. Doubts: CI runs hooks without a model, claude -p only ran locally; I did not re-run a depth-1 clone at this head, but CI's shallow PR checkout is green.
